title: Selective, Risk-Controlled Emotion Forecasting in Conversation: From a Persistence Barrier to Departure Detection with Conformal Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2611.05896v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting emotion in conversation is increasingly framed as predicting the next emotional state's value. We show this targets a hard quantity in a state-observed testbed and propose a learnable, deployable reformulation instead. On valence-arousal-dominance trajectories from a dyadic corpus, repeating a speaker's own previous state sets a persistence baseline that no frozen-encoder correction meaningfully improves upon and a state-space filter exceeds; the floor requires the historical state to be observed, since an estimated anchor collapses persistence below a direct forecaster. What survives is the timing of a departure from persistence, learnable on three of four corpora and near chance on the highest-base-rate corpus, a negative result we report. We recast the task as selective departure forecasting: a lead-time-weighted metric with a leakage protocol, and commitment policies whose best choice switches with the departure rate. A d

translated_title: 对话中的选择性、风险可控情绪预测：从持续性屏障到带共形保证的偏离检测
translated_abstract: 对话中的情绪预测日益被界定为预测下一情绪状态的数值。我们表明，在一个状态可观测的测试环境中，这是一个难以逼近的目标，并提出了一种可学习、可部署的任务重构方案。在一个双人对话语料库的效价-唤醒度-支配度轨迹上，重复说话者自身前一个状态构成了一个“持续性”基线，任何冻结编码器的修正都无法对其产生实质性改进，而状态空间滤波器则可以超过它；该下限的存在依赖于历史状态可被观测，因为若使用估计的锚点，持续性基线会跌至低于直接预测器的水平。真正可存活下来的是对偏离持续性时机的检测：该任务在四个语料库中的三个上可被学习，而在基率最高的语料库上接近随机水平，我们如实报告了这一负面结果。我们将该任务重构为选择性偏离预测：提出一种带泄漏防控协议的提前期加权评估指标，以及一组承诺策略——其最优选择会随偏离率的变化而切换。[原摘要在此处被截断]
tldr: 该论文发现对话情绪预测被“重复上一状态”的持续性基线所主导且难以改进，因而将任务重构为对情绪偏离持续性时机的选择性检测，并提出提前期加权指标、随偏离率自适应切换的承诺策略以及带共形保证的风险控制。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that conversational emotion forecasting is dominated by a hard-to-beat persistence baseline, so it recasts the task as selective detection of departures from persistence, introducing a lead-time-weighted metric, commitment policies that switch with departure rates, and conformal risk guarantees.
